notes: Top 50 airports by T-100 passenger (AIRCRAFT_CONFIG=1) departures, Jan-Mar 2019, ties by code; only airports with coordinates in project/data/airports.csv (none excluded).
Nonstop observed = directional T-100 segment with >= 13 departures and a usable passenger/seat count; otherwise point_to_point is an exact copy of hub_and_spoke (ADR 0007, strict).

DB1B passengers are the 10% sample scaled x10; hub = intermediate airport with most one-stop passengers whose two legs are both observed (ties by code); share_of_connecting_passengers divides by ALL one-stop passengers for the directed OD.
DB1B rows whose AirportGroup does not start at Origin and end at Dest are ignored (0 rows).

Fuel and NOx per flight are departure-weighted over mapped aircraft types; unmapped types are excluded and NOT rescaled (unmapped_share is reported per leg). Per-passenger values divide by seats_per_departure * load_factor.
OpenAP fuel/NOx is evaluated at the leg great-circle distance rounded to the nearest 10 nm and cached per (OpenAP code, distance); profiles use the nearest 50 nm (minimum 50) and at most 120 points.

Size: aircraft types with a departure share below 1% on a leg are merged into one 'other' entry in aircraft_mix (openap null, range null); fuel, NOx, unmapped_share and profile_key were computed from the full mix before merging.
Rounding: *_per_passenger 4 decimals; shares and load factors 5; all other floats 2. Totals of rounded legs may differ from the rounded route total by less than 1e-4 kg per passenger.
Pairs with a leg that is not observed (empty aircraft_mix, fuel 0.0): 0.
